description:
In a world where hair care companies tout their product as the one you can't live without, with "cutting-edge" technology that will reverse your hair loss, grow new hair, and give you a solid return on your investment portfolio, it's refreshing to see someone take a more honest approach. The people behind Hairprint have created a line of products that cut through the nonsense and help us achieve healthier hair + scalps. The only way hair quality actually improves is if we fundamentally change our hair care practices, stop dousing our scalp with chemicals, and change our diet. Hairprint helps us do just that in their use of unique and specific botanicals that heal, exfoliate, stimulate and soothe the scalp. Their dedication to honesty and high-quality ingredients has produced a line of truly extraordinary products that we are delighted to share with the Carbon Beauty community!


Hairprint uses fewer ingredients but they also use more of them! Shampoo labels may list many botanical ingredients and oils, but how much is actually in the product? In many cases, almost none! One-tenth of one percent is not unusual as the workers who make these shampoos call it “fairy dust.” If your hair is 12 inches long, one tenth of one percent of a dab of shampoo means you are putting on 3/1000th of an ounce on 25 sq. ft. of hair surface. It is important to have enough of an ingredient to actually make a difference, which is why Hairprint measures and adds all of their plant ingredient formulations in percentages, not fractions of a percentage.

שברו את מחזור השמפו, שטפו וחזרו עם ניקוי נגד שאריות. הנוסחה העדינה שלנו עם pH מאוזנת עם תמציות שמן קוקוס מנקה את השיער שלך באופן עוצמתי, והופכת קווצות כבדות לברק חסר משקל ומשגע

מגן
חדור בשמן זרעי Moringa Oleifera ניקוי נגד שאריות מגן ואוטם שמנים טבעיים לשיער רך וניתן לשליטה. שמן מורינגה מעניק לחות לקרקפת, מעשיר כל שורש וזקיק השיער בוויטמינים ומינרלים מרעננים כדי לייצר מלאות בריאה ועמידות בפני נזקים.

לחות

בין אם יש לכם שיער ישר, מתולתל, גלי, עבה או עדין, הניקוי נגד שאריות נועד לנקות את המנעולים שלכם בקלות ולתת לכם ברק בחזרה. אנו ממליצים להשתמש בו מספר פעמים בשבוע לשיער עדין, שמנוני, פגום מינימלי או שבועי עבור שיער מתולתל, גס, פגום. עקבו עם מסכת הלחות Unwash לניהול לחות עוד יותר ומגע גימור עדין.

Fennel Aromatic plant distributed in the temperate zones of the whole world but native to southern Europe, particularly the coast of the Mediterranean Sea. Hops Climbing plant that flowers between the beginning and the middle of summer. Its leaves are opposite palmate and divided into 3 or 5 lobes. It contains lupiline, essential oil, tannins, asparagine, fatty acids, adenine and choline. It has sedative, relaxing and bacteriostatic properties. In cosmetics it is used for anti-dandruff and anti-hair loss treatments, toning and strengthening the hair in its growth phase. Thyme This is a small scrubby plant of the labiatae family. Its fruit is a brown tetrachene. It contains carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, mineral salts, phenolic compounds, terpenes, vitamin B1 and essential oils. In cosmetics it is used in toothpastes that strengthen the gums and prevent caries. It is used in creams for its anti-acne properties. It is also used in anti-dandruff shampoos for its antiseptic and toning action for the scalp.

Having previously had bad reactions with commercial shampoos and not being satisfied with the results from other natural shampoos, we were intent on finding a 100% natural solution that would gently and effectively clean hair and leave it with body and a shower-fresh smell, while containing no artificial chemicals, preservatives, or animal products. Botanicz is our 100% natural shampoo that’s made with powerful, organic essential oils with no artificial ingredients or preservatives to degrade the oil’s potency. Further, we feel so strongly about giving you the best possible benefits from our products that we make them all in small batches with an expiration date. This ensures that you can experience our products with the best purity, freshness and potency possible.

We have developed a proprietary micro emulsion process of infusing oils into water, naturally – it’s what sets our products apart, as we do not rely on any synthetics or preservatives. We change water into activated water. We invite you to check out our ingredients!

In health – Charles Floyd and Glenn Yeik of elomentz

临床证明可治疗头皮屑,并在皮肤科医生的控制下进行测试。 2.9% 活性水杨酸,高浓度的活性物经美国 FDA 批准。 不含硫酸盐、硅胶和对羟基苯甲酸酯。 不含人造色素。 天然配方*。 纯素配方。

*如果成分与天然状态未发生变化或经过加工,但仍保持超过 50% 的分子结构与原始植物或矿物质来源,就会被视为天然源。



Biolage R.A.W로 두피에 스트레스를 덜어줍니다. 두피 케어 샴푸. 이 두피 각질 제거 트리트먼트 샴푸는 2.9% 활성 살리실산 + 버드나무 껍질의 독특한 조합을 최초의 천연 포뮬러로 사용하여 벗겨지는 두피를 정화하고 비듬 제거에 도움을 줍니다.

살리실산이란 무엇입니까?
살리실릭이라는 단어는 버드나무 나무를 의미하는 라틴어에서 나옵니다. 나무의 껍질에 존재하여 박테리아에 저항하도록 도와줍니다. 살리실산은 세포를 결합하는 단백질을 용해합니다. 두피에서 개별화되고 분리되면 각질을 쉽게 제거할 수 있습니다.

The word salicylic comes from the Latin “salix”, which means willow tree. It exists in the bark of this tree, helping it to resist bacteria . Salicylic acid dissolves the protein that bonds cells together. Once individualized and detached from the scalp, flakes are easier to eliminate.

什么是水杨酸?
水杨酸这个词来自拉丁语“salix”，意思是柳树。 它存在于树皮中,有助于抵抗细菌。 水杨酸溶解将细胞粘合在一起的蛋白质。 一旦个性化并从头皮上脱落,就更容易消除剥落。

살리실릭이라는 단어는 버드나무 나무를 의미하는 라틴어에서 나옵니다. 나무의 껍질에 존재하여 박테리아에 저항하도록 도와줍니다. 살리실산은 세포를 결합하는 단백질을 용해합니다. 두피에서 개별화되고 분리되면 각질을 쉽게 제거할 수 있습니다.

Our Bioskin Junior Shampoo has especially been developed for those little ones who have dry and sensitive skin. Our award winning Shampoo has become a firm favourite for mothers who are looking to support their little one’s hair and scalp with the all the natural power this Shampoo has to offer. When our kids are still little, their skin is more sensitive than when they are all grown up. If your child on top of that also has a dry or itchy scalp, you want to make sure to use a shampoo that supports the skin even when washing – as the water can further dehydrate the skin!

Containing ingredients like Lavender, Rose Water and Calendula, the Shampoo will feed the scalp what it needs to gain strength, be soothed, nourished and feel hydrated.

Our Shampoo is also suitable for those children who may be prone to eczema, dermatitis, cradle cap and other skin allergies. Please know our Shampoo might foam less than what you might be used to from conventional shampoos. We opt to not use some of the synthetics used to create such foam as we believe it is gentler on the skin when using more natural foaming agents.

Revive and refresh oily hair and scalp between washes. Klorane Dry Shampoo with Nettle is especially formulated to control excess sebum for those with very oily hair. For best results, spray on roots and/or hair lengths and let absorb for 25 seconds before finger combing or brushing through hair. Or spray at night before bed to soak up excess oil overnight. For additional oil controlling benefits, alternate using Klorane Dry Shampoo with Nettle on dry hair with shampooing with Klorane Shampoo with Nettle on wet hair, and go even longer between washes.

Revive y refresca el cabello graso y el cuero cabelludo entre los lavados. El extracto de la planta de ortiga es conocido por su alto contenido en escopoletina, un compuesto que se encuentra en sus raíces que reduce el exceso de aceite y ayuda a regularlo con el tiempo, por lo que puede pasar días entre champús en lugar de horas. Para obtener los mejores resultados, rocíe sobre las raíces y/o las longitudes del cabello y deje absorber durante 25 segundos antes de peinar los dedos o cepillarse a través del cabello. O rocíe por la noche antes de acostarse para absorber el exceso de aceite durante la noche. Oder sprühen Sie nachts vor dem Schlafengehen, um überschüssiges Öl über Nacht aufzusaugen. O extrato da planta de urtiga é conhecido por seu alto teor de escopoletina, um composto encontrado em suas raízes que reduz o excesso de óleo e ajuda a regulá-lo ao longo do tempo, para que você possa passar dias entre xampus em vez de horas. Para melhores resultados, borrife as raízes e/ou comprimentos de cabelo e deixe absorver por 25 segundos antes de pentear ou escovar o cabelo. Fine hair

Fine hair is usually genetic, but it can also be the result of nutrient deficiency or poor blood circulation of the scalp. Due to dwindling hormone production with age hair can become thinner. Fine hair is thinner than normal hair, but there is more of it. It measures on average between 0.03 and 0.05 mm in diameter. It has less volume, is more sensitive and reacts faster to the frictional forces of hair brushes and combs, e.g. with electrostatic build-up.

ניקוי עדין
שברו את מחזור השמפו, שטפו וחזרו עם ניקוי נגד שאריות. הנוסחה העדינה שלנו עם pH מאוזנת עם תמציות שמן קוקוס מנקה את השיער שלך באופן עוצמתי, והופכת קווצות כבדות לברק חסר משקל ומשגע

מגן
חדור בשמן זרעי Moringa Oleifera ניקוי נגד שאריות מגן ואוטם שמנים טבעיים לשיער רך וניתן לשליטה. שמן מורינגה מעניק לחות לקרקפת, מעשיר כל שורש וזקיק השיער בוויטמינים ומינרלים מרעננים כדי לייצר מלאות בריאה ועמידות בפני נזקים.

לחות
שחזרו את הלחות הנכונה לשיער שלכם. יחד עם שמן קוקוס, שמן Babassu מנקה, מעניק לחות ומעניק לחות לשיער שלכם בחזרה לבריאות קלה וניהול. כל שטיפה מתקנת ומרככת את השיער בפחות שבירה וקצוות חלקים יותר.

ללא כימיקלים קשים
בחרנו בקפידה כל מרכיב כדי לתקן, לשחזר ולקדם ברק צעיר מהשורש לקצה. זה אומר להשאיר את כל הכימיקלים הקשים. ללא גופרית ופרבנים לשיער בריא ושקט נפשי.

כל סוגי השיער
בין אם יש לכם שיער ישר, מתולתל, גלי, עבה או עדין, הניקוי נגד שאריות נועד לנקות את המנעולים שלכם בקלות ולתת לכם ברק בחזרה. אנו ממליצים להשתמש בו מספר פעמים בשבוע לשיער עדין, שמנוני, פגום מינימלי או שבועי עבור שיער מתולתל, גס, פגום. עקבו עם מסכת הלחות Unwash לניהול לחות עוד יותר ומגע גימור עדין.

-ניקוי נגד שאריות כביסה
-מנקה את השיער מבלי להפשיט שמנים טבעיים
-לכל סוגי השיער
-זמין ב-70.9 גרם ובמידות 283.5 גרם ניקוי עדין

Sanfte Reinigung.
Den Zyklus des Shampoos durchbrechen, abspülen und mit der Anti-Rückstände von Unwash wiederholen. Unsere sanfte pH-ausgewogene Formel mit Kokosöl-Extrakten reinigt Ihr Haar kraftvoll und verwandelt beschwerte Strähnen in schwerelosen, wunderschönen Glanz.

Schützt
Angereichert mit Moringa Oleifera Samenöl, schützt und versiegelt natürliche Öle für weiches, frisierbares Haar. Moringa-Öl spendet Feuchtigkeit bis zur Kopfhaut und bereichert jede Wurzel und Haarfollikel mit verjüngenden Vitaminen und Mineralien, um gesunde Fülle und beschädigungsresistente Belastbarkeit zu erzeugen.

Spendet Feuchtigkeit.
Stellen Sie die richtige Feuchtigkeit für Ihr Haar wieder her. Zusammen mit Kokosnussöl reinigt, spendet Babassu-Öl Feuchtigkeit und versorgt Ihr Haar wieder zu frisierbarem, leichtem Gewicht. Jedes Waschen repariert und macht das Haar weich für weniger Haarbruch und glattere Enden.

Keine aggressiven Chemikalien.
Wir haben jede Zutat sorgfältig ausgewählt, um den jugendlichen Glanz von der Wurzel bis zum Ende zu reparieren, wiederherzustellen und zu fördern. Das bedeutet, dass alle aggressiven Chemikalien ausgelassen werden. Es ist sulfat- und parabenfrei für gesundes Haar und Seelenfrieden.

Für alle Haartypen.
Egal ob Sie glattes, lockiges, welliges, dickes oder feines Haar haben, die Anti-Rückstände-Reinigung wurde entwickelt, um Ihre Locken mit Leichtigkeit zu reinigen und Ihnen wieder Glanz zu verleihen. Wir empfehlen, es mehrmals pro Woche für feines, öliges, minimal geschädigtes Haar oder wöchentlich für lockiges, grobes und geschädigtes Haar zu verwenden. Folgen Sie mit der Unwash Hydrating Mask für noch mehr Feuchtigkeitsmanagement und einen feinen letzten Schliff.

- Spülen Sie keine Rückstände ab.
- Reinigt das Haar sanft, ohne natürliche Öle zu entfernen.
- Für alle Haartypen.
- Erhältlich in den Größen 70,9 g und 284,5 g. Sanfte Reinigung.

Limpeza suave
Quebre o ciclo de xampu, enxágue e repita com a limpeza antiresíduos não lavada. Nossa fórmula suave com pH equilibrado com extratos de óleo de coco limpa seu cabelo, transformando fios pesados em um brilho leve e lindo.

Protege
Infundido com óleo de semente de Moringa Oleifera, sua limpeza antiresíduos protege e veda óleos naturais para cabelos macios e fáceis de manusear. O óleo de moringa hidrata até o couro cabeludo, enriquecendo cada raiz e folículo capilar com vitaminas e minerais rejuvenescedores para produzir volume saudável e resiliência resistente a danos.

Hidrata.
Restaura a umidade adequada para o seu cabelo. Junto com o óleo de coco, o óleo de babaçu limpa, hidrata e hidrata o seu cabelo de volta para uma saúde leve e gerenciável. Cada lavagem repara e suaviza o cabelo para menos quebra e pontas mais suaves.

Sem produtos químicos agressivos.
Selecionamos cuidadosamente cada ingrediente para reparar, restaurar e promover um brilho jovem da raiz às pontas. Isso significa deixar de lado todos os produtos químicos agressivos. É livre de sulfatos e parabenos para cabelos saudáveis e tranquilidade.

Todos os tipos de cabelo.
Se você tem cabelos lisos, encaracolados, ondulados, grossos ou finos, a limpeza antiresíduos é projetada para limpar seus cachos com facilidade e dar brilho de volta. Recomendamos usá-lo várias vezes por semana para cabelos finos, oleosos, minimamente danificados ou semanalmente para cabelos cacheados, grossos e danificados. Acompanhe a máscara hidratante sem lavagem para ainda mais gerenciamento de umidade e um toque final.

- Limpeza antiresíduos não lavar
- Limpa o cabelo sem descascar óleos naturais
- Para todos os tipos de cabelo.
- Disponível nos tamanhos 70 g e 283 g de limpeza suave.

温和清洁
用Unwash抗残留洁面乳来打破洗发水,冲洗并重复洗发水。 我们的温和 pH 平衡配方含有椰子油提取物,能有效清洁您的头发,将重发丝变成轻盈、华丽的光泽。

保护
加入辣木油籽油，您的抗残留清洁剂保护和密封天然油脂，打造柔软、易打理的头发。 辣木油滋润至头皮,滋养每根根根和毛囊,恢复维生素和矿物质,产生健康丰盈和抗损的弹性。

保湿和保湿:
恢复头发的适当水分。 除了椰子油之外,Babassu 油还可以清洁、滋润和滋润您的秀发,恢复易打理、轻盈健康。 每次洗涤都能修复和软化头发,减少断裂和平滑发梢。

不含刺激性化学品
我们精心挑选每种成分,从根部到尾修复、恢复和促进年轻光泽。 这意味着不会残留所有刺激性化学物质。 不含硫酸盐和对羟基苯甲酸酯,健康头发,让您安心无忧。

所有头发类型
无论您是直发、卷曲、波浪、浓密或细发,这款防残留清洁产品旨在轻松清洁您的锁具,让您恢复光泽。 我们建议每周使用几次,修剪细长、油性、轻微受损的头发,或每周用于卷发、粗糙、受损头发。 然后使用未洗保湿面膜,以获得更多的水分管理和精细润泽。

- 无需洗涤,防残留清洁
- 温和清洁头发,不脱落天然油脂
- 适合所有发质
- 提供 2.5 盎司和 10 盎司尺寸温和清洁

description:
What is Bio-based plastic?

Bio-based plastic is made from renewable, natural materials. Such as corn, potato, tapioca or wheat starch, bamboo cellulose and sugar cane. Through modification and plasticization, these raw materials are turned into Bio-based plastic, which is an environmental friendly, versatile material with a significantly smaller carbon footprint.

Why we use Bio-based plastic?

The most important thing that Bio- based plastics have over conventional plastics is that they are made from (grown ) crops instead of fossil fuels . This means that increased demand for Bio-based plastics results in decreased demand for fossil fuels .

What we do now?

We’re committed to making products and packaging with the highest possible plant-based content, and we don’t use any additives that have been identified as being potentially hazardous to human health or the environment. We’re not trying to hit a minimum standard. We’re trying to drop-kick fossil fuels and hazardous chemicals out of the products and packaging in our everyday lives.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I use Episilk™ Shampoo w/ my other hair care products?

Yes. Episilk™ Shampoo can be used w/ any other hair products & works especially well when used prior to using Episilk™ Conditioner.

What can Hyaluronic Acid do for my hair & scalp?

Structurally the scalp is identical to the skin tissue located throughout the body except it also contains about 100,000 hair follicles that give rise to hair. Actually, the hair & the hair follicle are a derivative of skin tissue. There are two distinctive skin layers, one, the epidermis (outer layer) which gives rise to the protective shield of the body & the other, the dermal layer (deep layer) which makes up the bulk of the skin & is where the hair follicle is located.

This dermal layer is composed of connective tissue & the connective tissue, w/ its gelatinous fluid like characteristics provides support, nourishes & hydrates the deep layers of the scalp. The result is healthy lustrous hair & a moisturized scalp. Again, all of this is made possible because of the presence of HA in the scalp tissue & its ability to form this fluid & hold water.

¿Qué puede hacer el ácido hialurónico para mi cabello y cuero cabelludo?

Estructuralmente el cuero cabelludo es idéntico al tejido de la piel ubicado en todo el cuerpo, excepto que también contiene alrededor de 100.000 folículos pilosos que dan lugar al cabello. En realidad, el cabello y el folículo piloso son un derivado del tejido de la piel. Hay dos capas distintivas de la piel, una, la epidermis (capa externa) que da lugar al escudo protector del cuerpo y el otro, la capa dérmica (capa profunda) que compone la mayor parte de la piel y es donde se encuentra el folículo piloso.

Esta capa dérmica se compone de tejido conectivo y el tejido conectivo, con su líquido gelatinoso como características proporciona soporte, nutre e hidrata las capas profundas del cuero cabelludo. Strukturell ist die Kopfhaut identisch mit dem Hautgewebe, das sich im ganzen Körper befindet, außer sie enthält auch etwa 100.000 Haarfollikel, die dem Haar entstehen, Eigentlich sind die Haare und die Haarfollikel ein Derivat des Hautgewebes. Estruturalmente, o couro cabeludo é idêntico ao tecido da pele localizado em todo o corpo, exceto que também contém cerca de 100.000 folículos capilares que dão origem ao cabelo. Na verdade, o cabelo e o folículo capilar são um derivado do tecido da pele. Existem duas camadas distintas de pele, uma a epiderme (camada externa) que dá origem ao escudo protetor do corpo e a outra, a camada dérmica (camada profunda) que compõe o volume da pele e é onde o folículo capilar está localizado.

Esta camada dérmica é composta de tecido conjuntivo e o tecido conjuntivo, com suas características gelatinosas como fluido oferece suporte, nutre e hidrata as camadas profundas do couro cabeludo. O resultado é um cabelo lustroso saudável e um couro cabeludo hidratado. Novamente, tudo isso é possível devido à presença do HA no tecido do couro cabeludo e sua capacidade de formar este fluido e manter a água.

透明质酸能对头发和头皮有什么作用?

从结构上来说,头皮与全身的皮肤组织相同,但它也含有大约 100,000 个头发毛囊。 实际上,头发和毛囊是皮肤组织的衍生物。 有两个独特的皮肤层,一个是产生身体保护盾的表皮(外层),另一个是占皮肤的体积的真皮层(深层层),是毛囊所在地。

这款真皮层由结缔组织和结缔组织组成,具有凝胶状液体状特征,提供支撑、滋养和保湿头皮深层层。 其结果是健康有光泽的头发和滋润头皮。 再一次,所有的这一切都是可能的,因为透明质酸在头皮组织中存在,并能够形成这种液体和保持水的能力。

AGAVE FRUCTANS

JOJOBA OIL

description:
Mycodex Flea Tick Shampoo P3 is a richly lathering concentrated shampoo that kills adult fleas and ticks on contact removed loose dandruff dirt and scales. Specially formulated for pets with sensitive skin this shampoo is enriched with coconut extract aloe and lanolin to moisturize both skin and coat. Leaves the coat soft and full with a light fragrance.

Directions & Dosage

Shake well before using. Thoroughly wet the hair with warm water. Use Mycodex Flea and Tick Shampoo P3 full strength. Do not apply shampoo around the eyes. Apply 1 1/3 tablespoon shampoo for each 5 lbs of pet's weight to the head and ears then lather; repeat procedure with the neck chest middle and hind quarters and finishing legs last. Continue to work lather in for 3 to 5 minutes (this is an important part of the grooming procedure) then rinse thoroughly with warm water. For extremely dirty or scaly animals the above procedure may be immediately repeated.

Repeat as necessary but do not apply more than once per week for control of adult fleas and ticks. Do not use on puppies or kittens less than 12 weeks old.

bullet_point: [How it Works: Malapet's active ingredients work to remove bacteria and fungus on the animal's skin, Protects the skin against microorganisms and bacteria that can cause itching and skin irritation, Kills Odors, Lathers well, rinses easily, No Doctor's Prescription Required. For Cats and Dogs]
description:
What is Malapet Medicated Shampoo? Malapet is an antifungal and antibacterial medicated shampoo for dogs and cats. It helps to remove fungus and bacteria on your pet's skin.

How it Works: Malapet's active ingredients work to cleanse and protect the skin against microorganisms and bacteria that can cause itching and skin irritation.

What is Malapet Shampoo used for: Malapet Shampoo is a medicated shampoo used on dogs and cats for dermatological conditions responsive to Ketoconazole and Chlorhexidine Gluconate.

How should Malapet Shampoo be used: Wet coat thoroughly. Apply and lather over entire body allowing 10 minutes of contact time. Rinse completely with water. Repeat twice weekly until symptoms subside. Then use weekly, or as directed by your veterinarian.

What are the side effects of Malapet Shampoo: There should be no side effects if used according to directions. However, if skin irritation develops or increases, discontinue use and contact your veterinarian. Talk to your veterinarian about any side effect that is unusual or seems especially bothersome to your pet.

What special precautions are there?: Do not use Malapet Shampoo on a pet that is allergic to it or to similar products. Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes. If Malapet Shampoo gets in eyes rinse thoroughly with water and contact your veterinarian. Malapet Shampoo is for use on dogs and cats only. Keep out of the reach of children.

In the event of an overdose: Overdose as a result of using this shampoo are unlikely. If an overdose is suspected, or if you see any unusual signs, symptoms, or behaviors in your pet, contact your veterinarian immediately.

Recover is suitable for all ages and hair types, but recommended for men and women with visible signs of hair loss or thinning, and women over the age of 40, even if there is no visible hair loss. Each bottle lasts up to 3 months if used as directed, 2 – 3 times per week. A reduction in shedding can be seen in the first 2 – 6 weeks, and visible results are apparent after the first purchase. Peak results are seen between 9 – 24 months. All Actiiv products are vegan, gluten-free and cruelty-free.

Actiiv Recover의 특허받은 녹차 전달 시스템은 저희 샴푸가 모낭의 가장 깊은 수준에 도달하고 남성과 여성의 탈모의 주요 원인인 DHT(디하이드로테스토스테론)를 정화합니다. 이것은 시간이 지남에 따라 줄기 세포 염증을 진정시켜 머리카락이 두껍고 풍성하게 다시 자라는 건강함을 만듭니다. Actiiv Recover는 남성/여성 패턴 탈모뿐만 아니라 화학 요법, 갑상선 문제, 약물 치료, 산후 치료, 체중 감량, 최근 수술 등과 관련된 얇아짐과 빠짐을 포함한 다양한 유형의 탈모를 치료합니다. 회복은 모든 연령과 모발 유형에 적합하지만, 탈모나 얇아지는 징후가 보이는 남성과 여성, 40세 이상의 여성에게 권장됩니다. 각 병은 지시대로 사용할 경우 최대 3개월까지 지속됩니다. 일주일에 2~3회 사용할 수 있습니다. 빠짐 감소는 처음 2~6주 동안 볼 수 있으며, 첫 구매 후 눈에 띄는 결과가 분명합니다. 최고 결과는 9~24개월 사이에 나타납니다. 모든 Actiiv 제품은 비건, 글루텐 프리 및 동물 실험을 하지 않았습니다.
